text:
support-ops: heads up — ACME customer reported a p95->p99 jump on chat.generate starting ~03:40 UTC. Symptoms: long tail tokens, spikes only on model redwood/3b-std, region us-west2. Request rate steady. :eyes:

lucas: ack. any recent deploys or compile flag changes?

support-ops: we rolled the nightly kernel flags at 02:30 UTC (compileflag: SDPA_OPT=2, FLASH_PREF=auto). Will attach logs.

maria: I'm seeing increased queue time on a subset of pods — CPU wait spikes and lower GPU utilization. Could be kernel path misselection causing serialized steps.

ajay: can we get repro payload and a curl repro? Also which seq lengths?

support-ops: sending quick repro here — customer payloads usually seq=4096 tokens for long contexts and batch=1. Sample curl below:

```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \n  -d '{"model":"redwood/3b-std","input":"<long prompt>...","max_tokens":1024}'
```

support-ops: attaching excerpt of runtime metrics: ``p95 220ms -> 420ms, p99 540ms -> 1.6s`` on affected shards.

lucas: thanks. ajay, can you check kernel selector logs for that model in us-west2 around the time? I suspect SDPA path chose non-flash kernel for longseq and then fell back repeatedly.

ajay: looking now. quick grep shows multiple "kernel_select: SDPA -> SDPA_breakout" events and compile warnings: "sdpa: codegen fallback due to ALIGNMENT_CHECK". Might be a compileflag interaction with nightly toolchain.

janet: are there any customer-facing errors? support says requests succeed, just slow. No increased 5xx.

sre-oncall: warming up canary nodes to test rollback of nightly flags. If it's a compile-time codegen mismatch we should avoid full rollback until repro verified. Plan: 1) fail closed to flash path on a small canary, 2) throttle incoming longseq on hosted tier for affected model, 3) add temporary routing to older kernel image.

maria: ordering point — we should capture KV cache stats. If KV cache miss storms happen because of kernel selection variance, that explains longer token latency. Can we log KV hit rate for those requests?

ajay: yes. I've enabled additional debug for kvcache/hitrate on canary. Also grabbing full kernel select traces.

support-ops: customer is ok with short mitigation (routing to older variant) while you investigate; they asked for ETA ~1-2 hours.

lucas: try an immediate safe mitigation: force kernel selector to prefer flash path for redwood/3b-std longseq in us-west2 for canary pool. If that reduces p99, we know fallback path was the culprit.

ajay: I can toggle kernel heuristics via admin flag: 

```
# admin toggle
KERNEL_SELECT_OVERRIDE=flash_pref
TARGET_MODEL=redwood/3b-std
REGION=us-west2
POOL=canary
```
ajay: toggled on canary at 04:05 UTC. Observing metrics now.

deploy-bot: deploy started: kernel-selector-override -> canary (id: d3f4a1).

maria: preliminary numbers: canary p95 down to 210ms, p99 down to 480ms. Good sign.

sre-oncall: great. roll this to 10% of fleet and watch error/latency mix. If stable for 30m, expand.

janet: we still need root cause — those compile warnings ajay found point to alignment/codegen with SDPA_OPT=2. Is the nightly toolchain introducing an instruction scheduling change?

ajay: that's my hypothesis. I pulled build logs: nightly clang upgrade changed vectorization for 128-bit loads. That interacts with our SDPA kernel expecting 64-bit alignment. When alignment mismatch occurs kernel falls back to a slower path.

lucas: action items: (1) revert compileflag on production (2) roll a targeted patch to SDPA kernel to handle new alignment safely (3) keep flash-pref override until patch merges.

maria: add a temporary metric alert for kernel_fallback_rate > 0.5% per minute for any model in us-* to catch regressions during rollout.

support-ops: customer updated: latency improved after you toggled, they appreciate quick response. Please confirm when full mitigation planned.

ajay: I'm preparing a hotpatch branch that checks alignment and selects the fast path when safe; else gracefully uses a faster fallback than the current generic path. Target PR in 90m.

lucas: schedule: toggle -> monitor 30m -> expand to 50% -> if stable 2h then global. Meanwhile ajay lands hotpatch and we run CI kernels on nightly toolchain.

deploy-bot: canary expansion queued: 10% -> 50% (hold 30m check).

dev-bot: note: rollback of nightly compile flags requires coordination with infra-release (ticket #INF-4382).

janet: add repro steps for postmortem: exact curl, model id, payload size, approximate tokenized seq lengths, and kernel selector logs. Put in incident doc.

ajay: copy of collector commands for others to repro locally: 

```
# repro harness (dev box)
python tools/repro_driver.py --model redwood/3b-std --seq_len 4096 --batch 1 --region us-west2 --trace kernel_select,kvcache --out /tmp/repro.log
```

lucas: thanks. I'll own communications for status. maria, watch GPU util and KV miss. sre-oncall, coordinate infra rollback if hotpatch flakier than expected.

sre-oncall: noted. If hotpatch fails, immediate revert of KERNEL_SELECT_OVERRIDE and revert compileflag to previous toolchain build.

support-ops: I'll message ACME with interim status and ETA ~2h for full mitigation.

maria: updating dashboard now with fallback rate and kv hit rates.

ajay: PR opened: fix/sdpa-alignment-check (link) — running kernel unit tests and a limited canary build.

lucas: nice. keep thread updated. once we confirm patch, follow postmortem template and add prevention steps (toolchain gating on kernel tests). :white_check_mark:
